tiers.name: Standard Kubernetes Pod RollingRestart (Destroy Pod + Cold CUDA/CUDAGraph + Disk Load)
tiers.note: Takes replica offline for 185s per node to restart Python, re-init NCCL, reload 140GB from disk, and recapture CUDAGraphs!

tiers.name: Naive In-Process Second Model Allocation Before Freeing Old Model (`CUDA OOM`)
tiers.note: Cannot fit two 140GB models + KV cache on 8x80GB GPUs (OOMs unless 100% extra standby GPU nodes are provisioned for blue-green)!

tiers.name: In-Place Parameter Buffer Overwrite From Shared Disk (Keep CUDAGraphs Alive, Slow Disk I/O)
tiers.note: Reuses existing GPU weight tensor addresses (preserving CUDAGraphs!), but stalls serving for 14.2s while reading 140GB from disk.

tiers.name: Background Host Pinned RAM Pre-Staging + Graceful Drain + In-Place PCIe DMA Overwrite (`0.45 s`)
tiers.note: Pre-stages new 140GB weights into host pinned DDR5 while serving, drains in-flight requests, and overwrites GPU weight pointers in-place at 400 GB/s aggregate PCIe DMA in 0.45s (zero CUDAGraph recapture)!
